en.headline: Police seek information on missing 78-year-old man in Tsuen Wan
en.dek: Au Chun-cheong left his home on Lai King Hill Road on Friday afternoon and has not been seen since; officers issued a public appeal on Saturday.
body: Police appealed on Saturday for information on a 78-year-old man who went missing in Tsuen Wan after leaving his residence on Lai King Hill Road on Friday afternoon.

Au Chun-cheong is about 1.6 metres tall, weighs around 60 kilograms and has a thin build. He has a round face with yellow complexion and is bald. He was last seen wearing a grey short-sleeved shirt, blue trousers, grey shoes and a blue cap, and carrying a brown crossbody bag.
Anyone with information on his whereabouts is urged to contact the Regional Missing Persons Unit of New Territories South on 3661 1173 or 9078 1880, or any police station.

zh.headline: 警方尋找荃灣失蹤78歲男子區振昌
zh.dek: 區振昌於星期五下午離開荔景山路住所後失蹤，警方星期六發出尋人呼籲。
body: 警方今日呼籲市民提供消息，協助尋找一名於荃灣失蹤的78歲男子區振昌。他於星期五下午離開荔景山路住所後至今未見。
區振昌身高約1.6米，體重約60公斤，身材瘦削，圓臉、黃皮膚、禿頭。他最後被見到時穿灰色短袖上衣、藍色長褲、灰色鞋及藍色帽，並攜帶棕色斜孭袋。
任何人如知悉他的下落或曾見過他，請致電新界南總區失蹤人口調查組3661 1173或9078 1880，或以電郵rmpu-nts-2@police.gov.hk聯絡，或聯絡任何警署。
